svg.title: The plain kernel slides over the cover; each position gives one output number
svg.desc: Six frames in reading order; in each, the 6 by 6 cover with the current 3 by 3 window outlined in orange, the 4 by 4 output filled up to the current position, and the five kept products added up beneath.

g.text: Lay the kernel on a window, multiply cell by cell and add the nine products;
write the total, then move one cell.
